# dtcloud_volume_snapshots (Data Source)

Lists the snapshots taken of one volume.

Read-only on purpose: snapshots have their own service and their own routes, and creating one here would put two resources in charge of the same object.

What this is for is seeing what would be lost. Deleting a volume cascades, so destroying one destroys its snapshots too, and this is the way to check before running it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dtcloud_volume_snapshots" "of_data_volume" {
  volume_id = dtcloud_volume.data.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `volume_id` (String) ID of the volume whose snapshots to list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `snapshots` (List of Object) Snapshots of the volume, newest first — the API sorts by creation date descending. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshots))

<a id="nestedatt--snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshots`

Read-Only:

- `created_on` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `size` (Number)
- `status` (String)
- `storage_policy` (String)
